request.title: fix-the-build
request.last_prompt: How does the scheduler pick the next job?
request.last_message:
The scheduler admits jobs first-fit in queue order: each pass walks the queue and starts every job whose claim fits what the running jobs leave of the caps. A head that has waited past starve_after starts alone or holds the rest back, so big jobs can't be starved forever. Over-cap jobs are skipped rather than made the head.

Let me know if you want me to dig into any part of it.

request.title: fix-the-build
request.last_prompt: From reviewer: is it intended that deliverVerdict caches a dropped answer?
request.last_message: Yes, that's intended: a dropped answer is still a real answer for its turn, so a replay of that turn after a restart takes it back instead of calling again. It never applies to a newer turn, since the cache is keyed by the Stop's time.
